components.css: .ds-grid { display: grid; column-gap: 6.5px; max-width: 320px; } .ds-area { display: grid; gap: 7px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; } .ds-cells { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(var(--cols), minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 5px 6.5px; } @supports (grid-template-columns: subgrid) { .ds-area, .ds-cells { grid-template-columns: subgrid; } .ds-area-label, .ds-cells { grid-column: 1 / -1; } } .ds-area-label { position: relative; justify-self: center; min-height: 24px; padding: 0 6px; background: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Martian Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #8C9087; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-area-label::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -10px -6px; } .ds-area-label:hover { color: #E8E8E2; border-color: #3A3D37; } .ds-area-label[aria-pressed='true'] { color: #C6F432; border-color: #C6F432; } .ds-area-label:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C6F432; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-cell { display: block; aspect-ratio: 1; border-radius: 3px; border: 1px solid rgba(198, 244, 50, 0.3); background: rgba(198, 244, 50, 0.2); transition: opacity 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-cell-unmapped { background: transparent; border: 1px dashed rgba(232, 232, 226, 0.2); } .ds-cell-assisted { background: rgba(198, 244, 50, 0.42); border-color: rgba(198, 244, 50, 0.55); } .ds-cell-delegated { background: rgba(198, 244, 50, 0.68); border-color: rgba(198, 244, 50, 0.8); } .ds-cell-autonomous { background: #C6F432; border-color: #C6F432; } .ds-focus-company .ds-area:not(.ds-area-focused) .ds-cell { opacity: 0.08; }

components.css: .ds-stages { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center; align-items: center; gap: 4px 12px; } .ds-stage { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border: none; background: none; font-family: 'Martian Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: #7A7E74; cursor: pointer; transition: color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-stage::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 6px 0; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; transition: border-color 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-stage:hover, .ds-stage[aria-pressed='true'] { color: #E8E8E2; } .ds-stage:hover::before, .ds-stage[aria-pressed='true']::before { border-color: #7A7E74; } .ds-stage[aria-current='step'] { color: #C6F432; } .ds-stage[aria-current='step']::before { border-color: #C6F432; } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C6F432; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-stage-arrow { color: #7A7E74; font-family: 'Martian Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 11px; }

narrative.overview:
The page reads like an observation journal kept on a single human subject. A near-black darkroom field holds bone-white text, and every piece of metadata (dates, cycle numbers, statuses, section labels) is stamped in narrow monospace like a clinical entry. The voice is clinical, candid and unsettling: the system stays calm and procedural so the human crack in the copy ("Let's see what's left of me.") lands harder.

The first screen is a vital-sign readout, not a headline. One enormous condensed figure ("81% of him is still him") sits on top of the delegation grid, which acts as its meter. Tapping an area of the grid isolates its cells and the figure counts to that area's share, so the instrument answers the visitor's question in place. Density is low and deliberate below the fold: sections breathe with 48 to 96px of vertical padding inside a 1120px column, and content is separated by hairline rules rather than boxes. Color is almost absent. A single acid signal, Live-Wire Green, marks what is alive, delegated, actionable or flagged as sample data; everything else is a ladder of olive-tinted greys.

The page is also built to weigh almost nothing. There are no rasters anywhere: every visual is type or a CSS-drawn cell. Two self-hosted font files (about 54KB together), CSS inlined into the HTML, and roughly 1KB of compressed JavaScript for the grid. Weight is part of the world; a field log does not need a photo shoot.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first: Darkroom Black field, Bone Paper text, no light theme.
One accent, used as a signal of "live", "delegated", "act here" or "sample", never as decoration.
Two typographic voices: condensed Archivo for the subject, narrow Martian Mono for the experiment.
The readout figure and the grid are one instrument; isolation changes the number, never the layout.
Flat surfaces; structure comes from hairline rules, outlines and opacity.
Softly squared, outlined controls (4px) with tracked mono labels, never smaller than a 44px target.
No rasters, two font files, inline CSS, a kilobyte of JavaScript.

rules.name: The One Live Signal Rule
rules.body: Live-Wire Green means "live, current, delegated, act here, or sample". It never decorates and never fills a large area at rest; the only green fills are grid cells, the OBSERVE button on hover, and the skip link.

rules.name: The Termination Rule
rules.body: Termination Orange is reserved for failure: terminated experiments and invalid input. It is not a general warning or emphasis color.

rules.name: The Olive Cast Rule
rules.body: Every neutral, from Darkroom Black to Bone Paper, shares a faint olive hue (about 105° to 135° in OKLCH). Never introduce a pure neutral grey like #888 or a blue-tinted grey.

rules.name: The Green Ladder Rule
rules.body: Delegation is one hue climbing in opacity (0, 20, 42, 68, 100%). A new delegation state gets a step on this ladder, not a new color.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Archivo speaks for the subject; Martian Mono speaks for the experiment. Metadata, statuses, labels, notes and controls are mono; confessions, questions and descriptions are Archivo.

rules.name: The Stamped Label Rule
rules.body: Mono labels are uppercase with 0.06em to 0.14em tracking (tightest on the area labels, widest on section titles). Sentence-case mono is reserved for notes and the footer; lowercase mono for field text and placeholders.

rules.name: The Two Files Rule
rules.body: The whole type system is two font files. Width and weight come from Archivo's axes, not from extra families or extra files.

rules.name: The Still Instrument Rule
rules.body: Interacting with the readout never moves the layout. Captions shrink to stay on one line, the stage note reserves two lines of height, and isolation changes only opacity and the figure's digits.

rules.name: The Flat Lab Rule
rules.body: No elevation shadow, no gradient, no backdrop blur. If something needs emphasis, change its outline, its color, or the opacity of everything around it.

rules.name: The 44px Rule
rules.body: Every tap target is at least 44px tall. Small visual forms (area pills, stage pills) are drawn inside a 44px hit area, never shrunk to their drawn size.

dos: Do keep the page dark: Darkroom Black (#0A0A09) background with Bone Paper (#E8E8E2) text.
Do set every piece of metadata, status, label, note and control in Martian Mono; labels uppercase at 0.06em to 0.14em tracking.
Do separate sections and list rows with 1px Hairline Ink rules instead of cards or boxes.
Do express delegation level with the five-step Live-Wire Green ladder (dashed outline, then 20%, 42%, 68% and solid green).
Do use opacity (down to 0.08) to isolate a subset of the grid rather than adding new colors.
Do put a SAMPLE marker next to every number, list or date that is placeholder data.

Do hold the accessibility floors: functional text at 11px or larger, metadata notes at 12px or larger, tap targets at least 44px, text contrast at least 4.5:1, and every animation removed under reduced motion.
Do keep the page weightless: no rasters, the two existing font files (about 54KB), inline CSS, and about 1KB of JavaScript.
donts: Don't use Live-Wire Green for decoration, backgrounds or large areas; it marks only live, delegated, actionable or sample things.
Don't use Termination Orange for anything other than failure or invalid input.
Don't add elevation shadows, gradients or blur.
Don't introduce pure neutral greys or a second accent color.
Don't let an interaction reflow the hero; the readout and grid stay put while the number changes.
Don't add a looping animation; the live dot is static.
Don't add a third font file or a raster image to show what type and CSS cells can draw.
Don't set confessional or question copy in mono, or metadata in Archivo.
